_about: Marquis Harmon's coaching content as data, the parts the app adds on top of the research feed (brain/feed/loops.json and library.json, kept by the research agent). Plain language, no em-dashes. Wording is draft until Marquis approves it.

offers.line: Marquis's framework as a coach you can use today. Instant access.

offers.line: The G.O.D. Framework and mindset work for groups. By inquiry.

alan.open: I am Alan, Marquis's coaching in software form. Seven taps, no typing. We find the loop you are in, pick one move, and set a time.
alan.want: Start with what you want. Pick the closest one.
alan.loop: Now, where does it get stuck? Pick the one that sounds most like you.
alan.play: Here is the loop, and here is the move that gets you past it.
alan.commit: A move only counts if it has a time. When will you do it?
alan.sheet: That is your call sheet. It is short on purpose.
alan.counter: If you want company on this, here is what is on the counter.

referOutNote: If this feels heavy or constant, or you are not coping, please talk to a doctor or therapist. Coaching is not treatment.
